about: Old-town facade types for Secret Pigeon, exported by oldtown.py from the Basel reference library's facades/resolved.json (one decision per building), records.json (LoD2 centres and sides), the reference world's cache/facade-types.json (wall colours, shared with the Blender world) and cache/roof-classes.json (roof colour per LoD2 building from its classified faces). Colours sRGB hex; roof_m2: the classified roof area behind the roof colour; sides: LoD2 wall sides 3 m or longer, in decimetres from the centre (e0, n0, e1, n1). Rows hang from the eave line: st_draw is the storey height to draw (the cache's front wall filled exactly, see st_draw_of), m_top the band under the eave; each game wall's rows and ground floor follow the row rule version 3 (rows_of, game.template.html): the ground floor nearest gf_m that is at least min(gf_m, 2.6), on an arcade ground floor at least min(gf_m, max(2.6, gf_m - 1.0)).
